general.title: Colony: AI Investment Will Continue Despite Tech Selloff
general.summary: George Colony, Forrester Research Founder, Chairman & CEO says the AI boom may be entering a new phase. Custom chips could challenge Nvidia's dominance, while value shifts toward software. But the transition won't be smooth: companies must adapt to AI computing, or risk being left behind. (Source: Bloomberg)
